Resolves #21836

Each file-server instance in the unit spec gets its own freshness observer. A worker that runs the suite hooks again starts with a fresh count, and the taken-port checks keep their counters separate from the suite server.

Evidence: L2 (deterministic worker-reuse comparison and standard focused unit run) → L2 required (AC-1 and AC-2).

Micro-review eligible: mechanical fixture isolation in one existing test file.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: with global workers 2 and project workers 1, the original failed at count 2 with 17 other passes. All 18 passed on `cf60d5287d` under the same schedule. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the existing file-server spec still exercises both port-selection paths and the freshness assertion. The diff gives each server an observer and is confined to that spec. |

None substantive.

The comparison used the existing unit config with retries disabled and a per-project worker cap. The four-worker focused run also passed all 18 cases.

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-21T22:45:11Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — fixture isolation inside one existing spec; it teaches no architectural concept.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that the freshness observer outlived its server. It was created once, when the describe evaluated, so a reused worker that runs `beforeAll` again for another group counted into the old object, and the taken-port test's two servers counted into it as well. I read the spec at the exact head `cf60d5287d`. `freshness` is now created inside `beforeAll`, next to the server it watches, and the strict and lenient servers each get their own. Its only reads are `listening` and `requests` at lines 281–282, in one test that requests its own path, so no test relied on the count growing across tests. I looked for other per-group state the hook could leave behind and found none: `root`, `server` and `base` are all assigned in the same hook. The diff touches only that spec, as AC-2 asks. Every check is green at the head (`gh pr checks` exit 0). This is the leak behind my defect-note on `fileServer.spec.mjs:276`.

**Findings:** None.
